
{{alias}}( value )
    Returns the learning rate scheduler string associated with a supported SGD
    learning rate scheduler value.

    Parameters
    ----------
    value: any
        Learning rate scheduler value.

    Returns
    -------
    out: string|null
        Learning rate scheduler string.

    Examples
    --------
    > var out = {{alias}}( 'constant' )
    'constant'
    > var v = {{alias:@stdlib/ml/base/sgd/learning-rate-str2enum}}( 'constant' );
    > out = {{alias}}( v )
    'constant'

    --------
